No phone: sign in with SteamCMD
callpoint_translation: 无需手机：用 SteamCMD 登录

note: Steam 应用登录方式标题

original: The quickest: approve the sign-in in the Steam app on your phone, and setup does the rest.
callpoint_translation: 最快捷：在手机上的 Steam 应用里批准登录，其余交给安装程序。

original: No phone needed: you type your password into Valve's own SteamCMD window, never into HellForge.
callpoint_translation: 无需手机：在 Valve 自己的 SteamCMD 窗口中输入密码，绝不会输入到 HellForge。

original: No sign-in here at all: the Steam app on this PC downloads the build through its console.
callpoint_translation: 完全无需在此登录：这台电脑上的 Steam 客户端会通过其控制台下载版本。
note: Steam 应用登录方式提示

original: Open the Steam app on your phone, tap the Steam Guard shield, then the QR code scanner, and scan this code. Then approve the sign-in in the app. HellForge never sees your password, and nothing of the sign-in is kept.
callpoint_translation: 打开手机上的 Steam 应用，依次点击 Steam Guard 盾牌和二维码扫描器，扫描此二维码，然后在应用中批准登录。HellForge 绝不会看到你的密码，也不会保留任何登录信息。

original: No phone needed. HellForge gets SteamCMD, Valve's own command-line Steam tool, from Valve and starts it in a window of its own, with everything filled in except your password. Type your password in the SteamCMD window; it goes to Valve's own tool, not HellForge. If Steam asks for a Steam Guard code (by email), type it there too. SteamCMD then downloads build
callpoint_translation: 无需手机。HellForge 会从 Valve 获取 SteamCMD（Valve 自己的命令行 Steam 工具），并在其独立窗口中启动，除密码外全部预先填好。请在 SteamCMD 窗口中输入密码；密码只会交给 Valve 自己的工具，不会交给 HellForge。如果 Steam 通过电子邮件要求提供 Steam Guard 验证码，也请在该窗口中输入。随后 SteamCMD 会为你的账户下载版本
note: SteamCMD 登录方式说明前段；拼接动态版本号后接 @23

original: to your own account, and HellForge checks every file against Steam's hashes and moves it into this folder. Afterwards HellForge removes SteamCMD and what it remembered of the sign-in.

note: SteamCMD 登录方式说明后段；前接版本号，保留首空格
